response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang credentials, but the role demands native-level Japanese, deep C for UNIX, Linux kernel source modification, and embedded LAN-switch security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 networking) — none of which are evidenced. Japanese proficiency is not listed at all, which is a hard disqualifier, and his C experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments over a decade ago.
strengths: Long, varied engineering career with proven ability to learn new stacks and domains
Some low-level and performance-oriented experience (DLang low-latency services, C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD) and open-source contributions
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed — a required qualification for the role
No embedded firmware, Linux kernel, or network-switch development experience
No demonstrated security-domain knowledge (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, tamper detection)

key_factors.factor: General seniority and adaptability across stacks
